title: Tesla Extends Robotaxi Hours in Austin, Adds 111 Cybercabs
key_facts: Tesla extended Robotaxi hours in Austin by one hour, to 11 p.m. from 10 p.m.
Announced on X by the Robotaxi account; Musk confirmed
Tesla targets 24/7 Robotaxi as early as this month with FSD v15
Musk said night driving needs animals to be spotted on the road, 'extremely careful with autonomous safety'
Texas DMV data: Cybercabs registered in Austin rose to 169; 111 added in two weeks, no major issues reported in a month of rides
quote_evidence: Tesla has extended its Robotaxi operating hours in Austin by an hour, and the Cybercab fleet there is growing quickly.
The total number of Cybercabs registered to operate in Austin now stands at 169.
why_it_matters_hint: Tesla's driverless service is stretching its hours and its fleet in Austin, its only Cybercab market.
notes: Enthusiast outlet; fleet numbers are from Texas DMV data as read by the outlet; 24/7 is a target, not a commitment.
